title: Component-mismatches only sees the dependency graph through germinate
description:
Component-mismatches only sees the dependency graph through germinate
output. Germinate has seed blocklists that hide dependencies, which
means they don't show up in component-mismatches. For example,
!module-assistant hiding broadcom-sta's Recommends on universe
(https://github.com/ubuntu/ubuntu-project-docs/issues/41). Furthermore,
binaries that are not reachable from a seed are not traversed at all.
This is intended behaviour for main because universe recommends for
unseeded main packages are tolerated, but not for restricted because
all binaries in restricted are supported.

This fix adds a secondary check for restricted binary packages using
data parsed from Packages, and not reliant on germinate data.

@@ -215,6 +231,41 @@ def add_built_using(options):

+def add_restricted_dependencies(options, source_add, binary_add):
+    for binary in sorted(restricted_dependencies):
+        if archive_binary[binary][1] != "restricted":
+            continue
+        for field, alternatives in restricted_dependencies[binary]:
+            satisfied = False
+            target = None
+            for alternative in alternatives:
+                if alternative in archive_binary:
+                    if archive_binary[alternative][1] in options.components:
+                        satisfied = True
+                        break
+                    if target is None:
+                        target = alternative
+                    continue
+                providers = sorted(package_provides.get(alternative, ()))
+                if any(archive_binary[provider][1] in options.components
+                       for provider in providers):
+                    satisfied = True
+                    break
+                if target is None and providers:
+                    target = providers[0]
+            if satisfied or target is None or target in binary_add:
+                continue
+            if field == 'Recommends':
+                why = "%s (Recommends)" % binary
+            else:
+                why = binary
+            source = archive_binary[target][2]
+            binary_add[target] = (source, why, None, None)
+            if source not in current_source and source not in source_add:
+                source_add.append(source)
+    source_add.sort()
+
+
 def is_included_binary(options, pkg):
